BrandLogo.tsx: wordmark='column' uses alignItems:'center' (styles.column) → welcome-logo centering is driven by the wrap View, confirmed centered within the welcome AuthShell content (diff 0.0 px at 390 px viewport).

server.py: _run_estimation applies env_pct AFTER base estimation then re-rounds low/high to 1000 € (lines 103-105). The ±5% band is enforced in estimator.py:435-436 (RANGE_HALF=0.05) and preserved through env adjustments within ±1000 € tolerance — observed 115k → 109k/121k.

ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ allowsMultipleSelection:true }) on web triggers a standard <input type='file' multiple> under the hood → page.expect_file_chooser() works as expected.
No regression on iteration 23 environment flow — cached response <1s, all 12 report sections present, env_* adjustments total +1.5% visible on property detail.
